nodes.label: ADR-010 — Modos LOCAL/REMOTO e MAN/AUTO com transferência bumpless
Decision: two mode axes — LOCAL/REMOTO (PID vs MPC, bumpless both ways via PID mode writes AUTO<->RCAS/CAS/ROUT) and MAN/AUTO sub-mode of REMOTO; MV tracking in LOCAL
nodes.rationale: MPC takes over and hands back loops that have conventional PID in the PLC without MV jumps (APC shed hierarchy). Bumpless requires the block MV to track the real PID MV readback while in LOCAL so takeover starts at the live value; the PID target mode (RCAS/CAS/ROUT) determines what the MPC writes per MV; in LOCAL the system never writes MV.
